name: Gästehaus Gruber
beschreibung: Gästehaus Gruber is situated in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, offering comfortable holiday apartments. Its peaceful setting within the village ensures short and convenient distances to local shops and services. The surrounding mountain panorama is a dream come true for active travelers throughout summer and winter. The spacious holiday apartments are furnished in a contemporary style and feature fully equipped kitchens. Guests can unwind and take in the fresh alpine air from their private balcony or terrace. The welcoming ambiance is defined by genuine hospitality and relaxation. Hiking trails and the local ski lift are located within easy reach.
